messages:
rachel.finance: Quick pre-cutover check. New price sheet + A/B cohorts scheduled 02:00 UTC tomorrow. Need final confirmation on: permanent grandfather clauses, vendor rebate passthroughs, and any prepaid account handling. Please drop the final CSV link here.

diego_ops: Ops note: we'll run shadow traffic against the billing v2 pipeline at 01:00 UTC for 45m. That will not emit real invoices but will create logs for reconciliation. If shadow looks clean, we flip the export snapshot at 01:55.

ken.revops: Uploaded candidate CSV: https://drive.redwood/revops/rollout_candidates_v3.csv (edit access). Columns: account_id, cohort, rebate_vendor, prepay_flag, legal_note_ref. Please don't remove the header row.

rachel.finance: thx ken. Two asks: 1) someone from Legal needs to confirm clause 4.2 permanent grandfathering list. 2) We need a mapping of vendor rebate IDs to GL accounts — otherwise revenue recognition will be wrong.

ellen_sales: FYI a partner (AcmeAnalytics) has a contractually guaranteed rebate of 15% for Q2 in SOW #342. I added those accounts with `rebate_vendor=acme` and `legal_note_ref=SOW-342` in the sheet.

legal-bot: New legal comment: SOW-342 includes permanent-rate-protection per clause 4.2 only for accounts signed before 2024-04-01. Any accounts added after that date cannot be grandfathered without exec sign-off.

ken.revops: Noted — I filtered the sheet for sign_date <= 2024-03-31 and flagged 47 accounts as `legal-eligible`. Added `manual-legal` tag where ambiguous.

rachel.finance: Good. Regarding prepay: How do we handle prepay reserves? If prepay covers multiple billing cycles, applying new rates mid-cycle could create mismatches. Proposal: apply new rates on billing_cycle_start only; if cycle started before rollout, keep old rates until cycle end.

diego_ops: Agree. Ops will add a rule in the billing orchestrator: `rate.apply_at = billing_cycle_start`. We'll also set `invoice.emit_cutoff=01:55 UTC` and `export.snapshot_time=01:55`. I'll open a PR for the orchestration config.

billing-bot: Deploy pipeline alert: PR #1157 opened by diego_ops for `billing-orchestrator` config changes. CI checks pending.

ken.revops: Two edge cases found: (a) 12 accounts with prepaid annual credits that are invoiced upfront — they will not be sampled correctly in A/B if we only shadow. (b) 3 accounts use custom pricing engine (external connector). Marked `external-pricing` in sheet.

rachel.finance: For (a) let's exclude prepaid-annual accounts from A/B sampling, and treat them as a separate cohort `prepay-exempt`. For (b) we need a manual exception and likely legal/partner coordination.

ellen_sales: +1 on prepay-exempt. Also routing note: a small enterprise customer asked for a one-time promotional hold; they must remain on legacy pricing per their sales contract. I added them with `cohort=legacy` and `legal_note_ref=CNTR-778`.

legal-bot: Manual review required for CNTR-778. Legal will triage today; expect reply by 18:00 PT.

rachel.finance: Action items: 1) Ken: finalize authoritative CSV with columns (account_id, cohort, rebate_vendor, prepay_flag, legal_note_ref, final_approved_by) by 16:30 PT. 2) Diego: PR #1157 CI green + deploy pause rule and export snapshot config by 22:00 PT. 3) Legal: confirm lists for SOW-342 and CNTR-778 by 18:00 PT. 4) Billing-bot: ensure export snapshot is set to 01:55 UTC.

ken.revops: Working on it now. I'll also add a `revenue_gl` column mapping with tentative GL IDs for each vendor rebate. Please review.

diego_ops: CI passed for #1157 in staging. Deploy to prod scheduled in a 01:30 maintenance window if we get green from Legal.

billing-bot: Export snapshot parameter set to `01:55 UTC` in staging. Remember to set `dryrun=false` for final export.

rachel.finance: One more governance item: any `manual-legal` or `external-pricing` tags require exec sign-off before rollout. If legal can't confirm by 18:00 PT, those accounts will be excluded and moved to a follow-up migration.

ellen_sales: Acknowledged. I'll ping execs for sign-off on any high-touch accounts.

ken.revops: CSV link (final draft): https://drive.redwood/revops/rollout_candidates_v3_final.csv — I set `final_approved_by=ken.revops` on rows where finance already confirmed. Left `TBD` for `manual-legal` rows.

rachel.finance: Thanks. I'll review and sign the final column by 16:15 PT. If anything needs exec sign-off, call it out in the sheet with `exec_required=true`.

diego_ops: Ops standby. Will not flip export snapshot or run the prod deploy until I see `exec_required` is false for the active cohort.

billing-bot: Reminder: Shadow run at 01:00 UTC will create logs at `/var/logs/billing/shadow/2024-06-01/`. Archived snapshots available after run.

rachel.finance: Great work team. Keep approvals in-thread for audit trail. If Legal approves CNTR-778, I'll add them to `legacy` cohort now; otherwise they'll be migrated post-rollout. :white_check_mark: 

legal-bot: Legal confirmation for SOW-342: approved for accounts listed. CNTR-778 flagged for exec review.

ken.revops: Done — final CSV updated and permissioned. Closing loop from my side.

ellen_sales: Acknowledged, will escalate CNTR-778 to execs now.

rachel.finance: Closing this thread once I drop the signed CSV. Expect it by 16:15 PT.
